model_identity: independent AnyJev + Qwen; not commercial Jev
scope: frontend information hierarchy and interaction safety; no model/decision/backend changes

validation.fault_injection_scope: Synthetic network failures and delayed responses test frontend recovery only; they are not real model or network reliability measurements.
